measuredGitConfig.meaning: Config associated with the measured candidate Git tree; historical raw Windows working-tree config hash was not recorded.

evidenceBoundaries: Source/test bytes are reconstructed from immutable fd7ef0d2 Git objects, not an archived before/after working-tree snapshot of either measurement.
The Windows checkout uses core.autocrlf=true. Current raw checkout hashes/CRLF observations are recorded separately and are not historical measurement-byte attestations.
Git source text is not silently rewritten to CRLF or claimed to be the exact historical Windows bytes. AST site matching is the reviewed summarizer responsibility.
Both measurements exited 1 under the old functions=65 and branches=74 thresholds. Test success is distinct from successful native process exit or release approval.
The original 264-file test inventory is from fd7ef0d2. Later assertions added to SkillZonePage.test.tsx are not represented as having run in these historical reports.
No whole-workspace pre/post digest was archived. CI git diff --check does not attest a clean working tree at measurement time.
